description: OR-FREEZE: participant a creates scratch-q2-freeze-after-implicit-return.accdb with S(16 rows) and T(ID, M MEMO), closes and reopens it shared, then runs implicit transaction: Database.Execute of INSERT INTO T SELECT 2048 rows of 2000 characters returned, and signals. Participant b suspends a 0 ms after the signal, records the database and lock files at once, after 1.5 s and after 4 s (the last two with the files kept), resumes a, waits 2.5 s and records them again. Asks whether the image a live writer leaves is stable while it is frozen at the after-implicit-return boundary and what changes after the resume, with no added Close, flush or lock transition.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-wire probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
